# Sakura Wars PS4RT v1.2

A Linux x86-64 update adding achievements, a game-language option, new internal resolutions and experimental ultrawide for **Sakura Wars (CUSA16429 v1.01)**.

## What's new

- **Achievements:** Game-triggered trophies are now tracked locally and shown in the overlay's **Achievements** tab, with icons, progress, hidden entries and unlock notifications. They are not synced with PSN, and trophies earned before this version do not unlock retroactively.
- **Game language:** A **Game language** option in the overlay switches the game between **English, French, German and Spanish** after **Apply and restart**. Trophy text follows the selected language. Saves are not changed.
- **Internal resolutions:** Choose the resolution the game renders at: 1024×576, 720p, 1080p, 1440p or native 4K. Changing it requires a restart.
- **Ultrawide (experimental):** 21:9 (2560×1080, 3440×1440), 24:9 (3840×1440) and 32:9 (3840×1080, 5120×1440) internal resolutions show more of the game world instead of stretching the image. Pre-rendered videos stay 16:9.
- **FSR 1:** A new lightweight spatial upscaler option alongside FSR 3.1 and FSR 4.
- **FSR fixes:** The FSR output resolution is now chosen separately from the internal resolution, and only matching outputs are offered. FSR 4 no longer brightens and dims near bright lights, and edges get correct motion with this game's depth format. FSR now works on the **Lowest** preset, and the Teletron and minimap display correctly with FSR at every internal resolution.
- **Stall fixes:** Removed GPU readback stalls that dropped frames at 4K.
- **NVIDIA startup fix:** Avoids a startup crash some players reported on NVIDIA GPUs.
- **Small additions:** **F12** saves a screenshot of the game image, the compact Graphics menu has the FPS counter toggle, and a first launch now starts in borderless mode.

## Install and launch

Download the **linux-x86_64** player archive and extract it into a writable directory. Supply your own extracted, plaintext **CUSA16429** game folder:

```bash
bash Play-Game.sh --game "/absolute/path/to/CUSA16429"
```

After successful setup:

```bash
bash Play-Game.sh
```

The game must be updated to **v1.01**. If your extraction is v1.00, the included setup interface can apply your matching update PKG. **This modifies the selected extracted game directory in place**, so keep a backup if you need the unpatched v1.00 files. The native update and optional DLC installers remain available; they do not download game content.

**Keep your save data when upgrading:** saves, achievements and settings are stored inside the player folder, so a new PS4RT version starts without them. To keep your progress, copy `out/CUSA16429/user/` (save data and achievements) and `out/CUSA16429/ps4rt.ini` (settings) from your previous version's folder into the new one **before its first launch**. Copying later replaces any saves made in the new version.

## Platform and notes

- Linux x86-64, glibc 2.35+, Python 3, compatible Vulkan 1.3 GPU drivers.
- The portable player archive includes the required application libraries and PS4RT tools. No development toolchain is needed to play.
- This is experimental compatibility software, not a general-purpose PS4 emulator. No game files, firmware, keys, PKGs, saves, or DLC are distributed.

For troubleshooting, see `PLAYER_README.txt` in the extracted player directory and the repository README.

- Introduce the **Essentiel** design for launcher update dialogs, now branded **SO5 PS4RT-WIN Updates**.
- Clearly display installed and available versions, release notes, download/install actions and backup-folder access.
- Preserve real progress bars and phase information throughout the update process.
- Apply the same visual style to PKG extraction dialogs, with a clearer destination field and adjacent **Change folder** button.
- Prevent background tab changes while a selection popup is open. Improve keyboard navigation and skip unavailable choices.

### Technical overlay improvements

- Add distinct colors for frame rate, GPU, CPU and memory information.
- Keep panel geometry and value columns stable when readings or hardware/provider names change.
- Preserve all six positions, scaling and opacity controls.
- Improve CJK font support and retain **N/A** for unavailable measurements.
- Reduce unnecessary launcher redraws and correct retained-window edge rendering.

### Crowbar integration

- Add Crowbar Guide pause/resume and orderly exit support through [PR #14](https://github.com/Hoverbike51/Star-Ocean-Integrity-and-Faithlessness-PS4RT/pull/14) by @shinseiryuu
- Synchronize guest clocks and controller input across pause/resume, with movie-playback safeguards and trophy test-profile support.
- Retry state publication after temporary Windows file locks without repeating commands or losing the latest response.

### Documentation and validation

- Translate new interface text into all **12 supported launcher languages**.
- Extend the illustrated Markdown guides with new interface examples and a Technical-overlay color legend.
- Update PDF version references to **1.1.3**, preserving their layouts and screenshots.
- Add regression coverage for operation dialogs, overlay stability and Crowbar state publication.

*Star Ocean 5 PS4RT — Native Windows 10/11 Development Branch*


## Installation

1. Extract the **entire ZIP** into a writable folder.
2. Open **Star Ocean 5 Launcher.exe** at the package root.
3. Select your own extracted PS4 game directory or import a supported PKG.
4. Wait for validation and preparation, review your settings, then select **Play**.

Keep all supplied folders together. Players do not need Python, MSYS2, PowerShell or .NET. A compatible **x86-64 CPU** and a working **Vulkan 1.3 graphics driver** are required.

Open the in-game settings with **Insert**, or hold **L2** and click **R3**.

### Custom HUD preset can be obtained [here!](https://github.com/Hoverbike51/hoverbike51.github.io/tree/main/SO5-HUD-Layout-Studio)

### Take a look at:

- [Illustrated launcher guide](docs/LAUNCHER_GUIDE.md): setup, saves, video, input, updates and diagnostics.
- [Illustrated in-game menu guide](docs/IN_GAME_MENU_GUIDE.md): the five tabs, live settings and preset limits.
- [Complete Windows changelog](CHANGELOG.md): current changes, earlier development stages and known limits.

**No game files, firmware or keys are included.** Original project code, third-party components and game assets retain their respective authorship and licenses.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Hoverbike51/Star-Ocean-Integrity-and-Faithlessness-PS4RT/compare/v1.1.1...v1.1.3

# Valkyria Revolution PS4RT v1.3

A Linux x86-64 update adding achievements, an experimental 60 FPS mode, new internal resolutions and experimental ultrawide for **Valkyria Revolution (CUSA06810)**.

## What's new

- **Achievements:** Game-triggered trophies are now tracked locally and shown in the overlay's **Achievements** tab, with icons, progress, hidden entries and unlock notifications. They are not synced with PSN, and trophies earned before this version do not unlock retroactively.
- **60 FPS (experimental):** An **Engine frame rate** option runs the game at 30 (original) or 60 and switches live. Game speed stays normal. Some animations or timings may still differ from the original; switch back to 30 if something misbehaves.
- **Internal resolutions:** Choose the resolution the game renders at: 1024×576, 720p, 1080p, 1440p or native 4K. Changing it requires a restart.
- **Ultrawide (experimental):** 21:9 (2560×1080, 3440×1440), 24:9 (3840×1440) and 32:9 (3840×1080, 5120×1440) internal resolutions show more of the game world instead of stretching the image. The HUD stays in a centred 16:9 area. Pre-rendered videos stay 16:9.
- **FSR 1:** A new lightweight spatial upscaler option alongside FSR 3.1 and FSR 4.
- **FSR fixes:** The FSR output resolution is now chosen separately from the internal resolution, and only matching outputs are offered. Talk portraits are now upscaled with the scene instead of stretched, and they and the narration panel no longer shake. FSR 4 no longer leaves trails of outlines in the pencil-sketch smokescreen effect.
- **Graphics quality:** A **Graphics quality** option (Max, High, Low) for slower GPUs: High draws lower-resolution shadows and Low turns them off. Changing it requires a restart.
- **NVIDIA startup fix:** Avoids a startup crash reported on NVIDIA GPUs.
- **Cutscene fixes:** Fixed some existing game bugs in cutscenes.

## Install and launch

Download the **linux-x86_64** player archive and extract it into a writable directory. Supply your own extracted, plaintext **CUSA06810** game folder:

```bash
bash Play-Game.sh --game "/absolute/path/to/CUSA06810"
```

After successful setup:

```bash
bash Play-Game.sh
```

**Keep your save data when upgrading:** saves, achievements and settings are stored outside the player folder, in `~/.local/share/valkyria-revolution/`, so a new PS4RT version finds them automatically. Extract v1.3 into its own folder and launch it as before: your saves, settings and remembered game folder carry over, with nothing to copy. If you used `--data-dir`, pass the same folder to v1.3.

## Platform and notes

- Linux x86-64, glibc 2.35+, Python 3, compatible Vulkan 1.3 GPU drivers.
- The portable player archive includes the required application libraries and PS4RT tools. No development toolchain is needed to play.
- This is experimental compatibility software, not a general-purpose PS4 emulator. No game files, firmware, keys, PKGs, saves, or DLC are distributed.

For troubleshooting, see `PLAYER_README.txt` in the extracted player directory and the repository README.
